glosses: to ovulate (to produce eggs or ova)

examples.text: Other studies have shown that women living near the equator have a marked tendency to ovulate during the full moon.
Ovulate flowers are usually isolated by enclosing them individually or in clusters in pollenproof bags […]

glosses: Liberar el ovario uno o varios óvulos para que sean fecundados. Llevar a cabo la ovulación.
Desarrollarse o madurar el óvulo o huevo.
Que pertenece o concierne al óvulo.
